headline: Brentford 1-2 Manchester City: Haaland and Foden rally champions to make it seven straight wins
whyCareReason: Manchester City overcome an early deficit to maintain their 100% record with 21 points, keeping Arsenal and Liverpool at bay in the title race.
teaser: FINAL: Brentford 1, Manchester City 2. Erling Haaland equalizes and Phil Foden fires the winner as City preserve their perfect record in Matchweek 7.
story:
Why this one matters: Manchester City preserved their unblemished start to the 2026-27 Premier League campaign with a gritty 2-1 comeback victory over Brentford at Gtech Community Stadium.

Bryan Mbeumo stunned the champions inside 19 minutes with a sharp counter-attack finish. City responded with relentless pressure, and Erling Haaland restored parity in the 34th minute, heading home Kevin De Bruyne's pinpoint cross for his 11th goal of the season. In the 68th minute, Phil Foden unlocked the Bees' defense with a crisp low strike from the edge of the box.

The victory moves Pep Guardiola's side to 21 points from seven matches, keeping their three-point buffer intact after Arsenal defeated Southampton 3-1 and Liverpool edged Crystal Palace 1-0.
stakes: City maintain their three-point cushion at the summit of the table with seven consecutive victories.
rivalryAngle: Guardiola's relentless machine overcomes another stubborn tactical hurdle in West London.
